# A different invoice for the same customer, asking for whatever credit they
# have, while another invoice's settlement sits loose from an unpost.
#
# `AutoApplyPayments` searches for open, owner-attached lots naming nothing and
# will take this one as readily as the rebuilt invoice's own — both name the
# same customer. What it must not do is have a bank's payment written down as
# a credit applied, which would take the account and the date it arrived by out
# of the export and the basis off currency the bank still holds.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

invoice "INV-USD-GRABBER"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Whatever is going"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-GRABBER"
		accumulate: true
